'''Frenos Three''' was an uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that hosted massive deposits of [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]]. The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] to use shell companies to buy up land rights on the planet and pay off key [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] officials in order to acquire the lommite.<ref name="TOR" />
